import cadquery as cq
import math

# === 参数 ===
wire_d = 2       # 线径 (mm)
coil_d = 15      # 簧圈直径 (mm)
pitch = 5        # 节距 (mm)
num_coils = 6    # 有效圈数

# === 建模 ===
helix_height = pitch * num_coils

# 螺旋线路径
path = cq.Wire.makeHelix(
    pitch=pitch,
    height=helix_height,
    radius=coil_d / 2,
)

# 截面
result = (
    cq.Workplane("XZ")
    .center(coil_d / 2, 0)
    .circle(wire_d / 2)
    .sweep(path, isFrenet=True)
)

show_object(result)
